name: Sickle Blade
disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) on the door frame or ceiling groove, or Interact to operate a lever on the opposite side of the door (in areas D2 and D4, respectively)
reset: The trap resets after 15 minutes. Additionally, a creature can manually Interact with the lever on the opposite side of the door to reset the trap.

items.name: Sickle
items.text:
Trigger A creature attempts to open the door

---

Effect A skeletal arm swings a sickle from the ceiling, making a Strike against the triggering creature.

text: A skeletal arm holding a sickle is concealed in the ceiling and connected to a mechanism in the sliding door below it.
